entries.6223ae855394736b: This business manufactures and sells isomerized sugar and grain saccharified liquids and other products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,564 million. It handles isomerized sugar (Three Sugar), glucose (Coso Glu Gunei), starch syrup (Maltofresh), oligosaccharide (Gunei Oligo), Puretose, grain saccharified liquids and cosmetic raw materials, which the company manufactures and sells.
